themes.reason: Explains why modern language study is valued as a subject in its own right, forming part of the rationale for why the government has chosen to specify this content as the intervention.
Details the specific transferable skills the specification aims to produce, directly justifying the design choices behind the proposed content and why this intervention was chosen over alternatives.
Addresses why the content is designed to suit all students regardless of further study plans, supporting the rationale for the chosen scope of the intervention.
A brief supporting point noting the qualification prepares students for degree-level study, adding to but not being the central basis of the proposal's rationale.
